items.title: 49% of marketers plan to deprioritize SEO, Typeface survey finds
items.excerpt: Typeface survey of 500+ US/UK marketing leaders: 49% plan to deprioritize SEO, 62% say brands trade content quality for AI citations, and many run AEO tactics they consider overhyped. Budget shift toward AI-answer visibility; vendor-run survey.

items.title: Brands turn to content series and Jimi Hendrix to improve AI search performance
items.excerpt: Fender and Marshall are funding branded content series and site overhauls partly to give the models behind ChatGPT and other chatbots more to work with, as brands shift spend toward AI-search visibility.

items.title: Tottenham Hotspur Launches Ask Spurs on Agentforce
items.excerpt: Tottenham unified 4.6M fan accounts across 10+ systems on Salesforce and launched Ask Spurs, an Agentforce AI agent with an 86% engagement rate, spanning ticketing, stadium events and commercial operations. CRM/sales AI. Primary source, but a vendor press release.

items.title: Google Ads lets PMax advertisers set Search partner spend to 0%, Marvin says
items.excerpt: Google Ads Liaison Ginny Marvin says Performance Max channel caps now allow 0% Search-partner spend via the API, while the help page still says coming soon. Gives advertisers more control over Google's AI-run campaign type. Note: the AI angle is indirect.
